messages:
maria: Quick pass — pasted the hero + intro for the launch post in the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-launch-draft. Please scan for any claim/benchmark flags.
jon: got it. high level looks good. can we tighten the latency claim? currently says "~2x faster than open-source baseline" — need the specific test config.
sam: tagging legal. @sam here — what's the source for the 2x number? need the exact benchmark name and test harness to approve.
maria: benchmark is from internal run last week, model A (quantized 4-bit) vs baseline B, 99 token median latency, aws-g5. I'll paste the test ID in the doc.
lee: for webinar CTA, we should call out the registration target and align timing. propose: "Live demo + benchmark deep-dive — Apr 14, 9am PT". ok?
rachel: timing conflicts with product team sprint review on Apr 14. can we do Apr 15 or 16? also recommend segmenting invite to early-access customers only for first wave.
maria: ok shifting to Apr 15. Lee — can you draft 1-2 lines for the CTA and what we'll demo?
lee: draft CTA: "Join a live demo where we show end-to-end inference throughput, cost breakdowns, and live Q&A. Seats limited (early-access priority). Register: <link>"
jon: back to claims — maria can you add the exact test command and config snippet? legal needs reproducibility.
maria: added in doc under "Bench methods":
```
./run_bench --model model-a-q4 --baseline model-b --seq 128 --batch 8 --hw g5 --runs 100 --seed 42
```
results: median latency 42ms vs baseline 87ms (2.07x).
sam: OK that's much better. two notes: 1) avoid superlatives like "best-in-class" without evidence. 2) please add footnote about internal run date and non-peer-reviewed.
maria: updated with footnote and removed "best-in-class" language. changed to "significantly reduces median latency in our tests".
jon: routing/inbound — rachel, how do we want the post to tag leads? current plan: UTM + HubSpot form + hidden field for product interest. Recommend UTM params below.
rachel: looks fine. add a lead_source = launch_post and route to sales queue "launch-nurture" for first 7 days then to SDR pool.
lee: UTM snippet to include in the primary CTA link:
```
?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=launch_post&utm_campaign=april_launch&utm_content=demo_cta&lead_source=launch_post
```
maria: perfect. @publish-bot can you schedule publish for Apr 8 10:00 PT and ensure embargo is respected?
publish-bot: scheduled publish: 2026-04-08T17:00:00Z. embargo flag set, notify #press when released.
sam: legal quick-pass ✅ — I approve the copy with the bench clarification and footnote.
jon: product ✅ on accuracy. rachel: ops ✅ on lead routing. lee: webinar CTA ✅. maria: can you lock final copy by EOD tomorrow so we can get the review board sign-off?
maria: locking copy by EOD tomorrow. thanks everyone 👍
jon: tiny nit — change the hero subhead to "Predictable, cost-effective LLM inference at scale" instead of "predictable and economical". feels clearer.
maria: updated. final doc link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1-launch-draft (locked for edits).
